en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 17. My father (RA) said: Sa`d ibn `Abd Allah said, on the authority of al-Qasim ibn Muhammad al-Isbahani, on the authority of Sulayman ibn Dawud al-Minqari, on the authority of Hafs ibn Ghiyath al-Nakha`I al-Qadi that Abu `Abd Allah al-Sadiq (AS) said:
“Whoever practices what he knows, suffices for what he does not know.”
